pages.finderGuideText:
Interactive Product Finder for K-Aqua Piping Systems

Use our innovative product finder to identify the exact right component for your specific piping installation. Whether you are looking for standard PP-R pipes for drinking water installations, fiber-reinforced PPRCT pipes for demanding industrial systems, or special transition fittings and valves – our tool filters the entire catalog in real-time. The product search helps you select by diameter (d20 to d630), pressure class (SDR class), and material.

A well-structured piping system requires precise planning and the exact combination of pipes, fittings (such as sockets, elbows, and tees), and the corresponding accessories. Our product finder eliminates time-consuming searches in static PDF catalogs and instead provides you with immediate, reliable data on item numbers, packaging units, and technical specifications. With just a few clicks, you can compile your material list and ensure the compatibility of the various components for heating, cooling, and drinking water systems. This not only optimizes your planning process but also minimizes errors when ordering materials for your next construction project.

extendedMarketText.p4: The water management challenges of our time require tailored, durable infrastructure solutions. K-Aqua is actively engaged in international markets to meet the growing need for hygienic and loss-free piping networks. Whether in water-scarce regions where every drop must be protected by leak-free welded joints, or in highly dense metropolises with complex requirements for fire protection and sound insulation: our PP-R and PPRCT systems provide the necessary reliability.
extendedMarketText.p5: We not only focus on pure product sales, but see ourselves as a strategic partner on site. Through technical training, on-site supervision, and close cooperation with local authorities, we ensure that international standards (such as DVGW, WRAS, SASO) are not only met but exceeded. This is how we make a sustainable contribution to the modernization of the global water infrastructure.

seoExpansion.p1: As a leading global manufacturer of PP-R and PPRCT piping systems, K-Aqua offers robust, resilient, and highly efficient fluid management solutions for drinking water, heating, and cooling networks. Our product portfolio ranges from standard PP-R pipes SDR 11 to special glass fiber reinforced multilayer pipes (PP-RCT), which offer exceptional resistance to extreme temperatures and high pressure loads. From domestic installations to massive industrial fluid distribution networks, our pipes ensure maximum operational reliability. Each pipe extruded using state-of-the-art German machinery is designed to remain absolutely leak-free over a lifecycle of more than 50 years. With a focus on hygiene, our drinking water pipes are certified by rigorous international testing agencies to prevent the growth of legionella and strictly maintain the purity and taste of drinking water in hospitals, hotels, and public infrastructure.
seoExpansion.p2: Beyond basic pipe architecture, K-Aqua offers an extremely comprehensive range of injection-molded fittings, transition joints, and heavy-duty valves. Our PP-R and PP-RCT fittings include elbows, tees, reducers, and electrofusion sockets that seamlessly fuse with the pipe infrastructure to create a monolithic, chemically bonded network that is virtually indestructible. We integrate precision-machined brass and dezincification-resistant (DZR) metal threads for perfect transition compatibility with existing metal plumbing components. To enable smooth installation, we offer professional polyfusion welding tools, from manual socket welders to massive hydraulic butt welding machines. This complete ecosystem ensures that contractors and engineers can rely on a single, unified system architecture for any complex installation requirement.
seoExpansion.t3: Sustainability, Life Cycle Assessment & CO2 Reduction
seoExpansion.p3: Sustainability is deeply embedded in the molecular engineering of our PP-R and PPRCT systems. By providing a remarkably low internal surface roughness of 0.007 mm, our pipes drastically reduce hydraulic friction and pressure drop throughout the network. According to Darcy-Weisbach dynamic flow models, this minimal resistance translates directly into a massively reduced energy consumption by circulation pumps. Over a 50-year operating lifecycle, this efficiency results in unprecedented CO2 savings and significantly lowers Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) for building and facility operators. In addition, polypropylene is 100% recyclable. Through our validated Type III Environmental Product Declarations (EPD) in accordance with EN 15804, we provide green building architects and planners with transparent, quantifiable data for LEED, BREEAM, and DGNB certifications.
seoExpansion.p4: Manufactured entirely in Germany under strict ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 50001 quality and environmental management protocols, K-Aqua exports premium piping solutions to over 50 countries worldwide. Our logistics network guarantees the fast and secure delivery of complete systems to megaprojects in the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and across Europe. Our relentless commitment to quality is validated by major international certification bodies, including DVGW, SKZ, WRAS, and KIWA. We support consulting engineers, BIM modelers, and major contractors with detailed CAD/BIM libraries, intelligent calculation software, and comprehensive technical support to ensure smooth project execution. K-Aqua represents the ultimate synthesis of advanced polymer science, sustainable engineering, and uncompromising reliability in fluid management.

seo.projektanfrage1: Are you planning a pioneering construction project? Send us your project request for K Aqua PP-R and PPRCT piping systems. Our technical department in Waldsolms specializes in the design and dimensioning of large installations. This includes demanding high-rise buildings, hygienically sensitive hospitals, extensive district cooling networks and complex industrial cooling and heating systems. Thanks to our decades of experience in polymer engineering, we understand the specific hydraulic and thermal requirements placed on the infrastructure of modern buildings. With K Aqua you choose not just a product, but a holistic system solution.
seo.projektanfrage2: As soon as you provide us with your detailed project specifications, P&ID plans or isometrics, our specialist engineers begin a deep analysis. We support you with complex pressure loss calculations, the determination of thermal linear expansion and the exact positioning of fixed and sliding points. We also create precise bills of materials and design tailor-made transition fittings for connecting to large metal components. Our goal is to design a hydraulically perfectly balanced pipe network for you that minimizes the energy consumption of your pumps and guarantees a maintenance-free service life of over 50 years.
seo.projektanfrage3: Discretion and reliability are our top priorities. Every project inquiry is treated strictly confidentially and processed exclusively by our qualified German engineering team. We also coordinate global logistics and ensure that our high-end pipes and fittings arrive at your construction site on time and undamaged. In addition, we offer on-site welder training by our certified instructors to ensure that the installation is carried out exactly according to the specifications of German Engineering. With K Aqua you ensure maximum efficiency, absolute freedom from leaks and the longevity of your entire piping system.

material.p1: PP-R Type 3 is not just a plastic. It is a highly complex, thermoplastic material that we master at the molecular level.
material.p2: Through the strategic arrangement of ethylene monomers in the propylene chain, we achieve unmatched impact strength, even at sub-zero temperatures. Our granulates come exclusively from the global elite of raw material producers. We analyze every batch using Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) and Melt Flow Rate (MFR) tests. Anything that misses our specifications by even a fraction of a percent is mercilessly eliminated.

co2.guideText:
Sustainability and LCA (Life Cycle Assessment)

Choosing the right piping system has a significant impact on the carbon footprint of a building or industrial facility. The K-Aqua CO2 Calculator provides a comprehensive Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) in accordance with EN 15804 standards. This analysis covers the entire lifecycle: from raw material extraction and product manufacturing (Phases A1-A3) to transport and installation (Phases A4-A5), the use phase (Phase B), and end-of-life (Phase C).

Compared to traditional metal pipes like copper or steel, K-Aqua's PP-R and PPRCT pipes boast a much more favorable environmental footprint. The lower energy required for plastic extrusion and the significantly reduced weight drastically lower CO2 emissions during production and transport. Furthermore, the mirror-smooth inner surface (roughness of just 0.007 mm) ensures extremely low flow resistance. According to the Darcy-Weisbach equation, this means circulation pumps require significantly less energy (electricity) to move fluids through the system.

Particularly during the use phase (Phase B), which for piping systems often lasts 50 years or longer, these energy savings translate into massive CO2 and cost reductions (Total Cost of Ownership, TCO). Even at the end of its lifespan (Phase C), polypropylene offers environmental benefits, as it is 100% recyclable and can be reused in a circular economy (Module D). Use this calculator to accurately and transparently quantify the ecological and economic savings potential of your K-Aqua project.

pipes.guideTitle: Comprehensive Guide: Planning and Installation of K-Aqua PP-R & PPRCT Piping Systems
pipes.guideText:
Comprehensive Guide: Planning, Material Science, and Installation of K-Aqua PP-R & PPRCT Piping Systems

Selecting the right piping material is the critical foundation for the longevity, operational safety, and energy efficiency of modern building and industrial infrastructures. Manufactured in Germany (Waldsolms), our PP-R and PPRCT piping systems offer a future-proof alternative to conventional metal pipes made of copper, steel, or brass, thanks to their excellent thermal, chemical, and mechanical properties.

Whether in building services for drinking water and heating networks, industrial plant engineering, cooling systems, or shipbuilding, K-Aqua pipes represent uncompromising German engineering and guarantee leak-free, maintenance-free operation for decades.

Material Innovation: PP-R and PPRCT in Direct Comparison

While standard Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PP-R) already exhibits excellent properties regarding corrosion resistance and hygiene, advanced PPRCT (Polypropylene Random Copolymer with Modified Crystallinity Temperature resistance) sets new benchmarks in piping technology. Through targeted modification of the crystal structure during polymerization, PPRCT provides significantly higher pressure resistance at elevated operating temperatures up to 95°C.

This material engineering advantage enables the production of pipes with thinner wall thicknesses (higher SDR classes) at the same pressure rating. The results for the user are outstanding:

  • Increased Hydraulic Flow: A larger inner diameter increases flow volume by up to 17% compared to standard PP-R pipes.
  • Reduced Pipe Weight: Material savings simplify transportation and handling on the construction site.
  • Higher Pressure Reserves: Maximum safety margins even under peak loads in continuous hot water applications.

Fiber Composite Technology (K-Fiber) for Minimal Thermal Expansion

A key aspect when planning hot water and heating lines is the thermal linear expansion of plastic pipes. K-Aqua addresses this challenge with innovative K-Fiber composite technology. The three-layer K-Fiber pipes feature a middle polypropylene layer reinforced with high-strength glass fibers.

This mechanical stabilization reduces the linear coefficient of thermal expansion to exactly 0.035 mm/(m·K), representing a reduction in thermal linear expansion of roughly 75% compared to non-reinforced solid plastic pipes. For specifiers and installers, this means:

  • Fewer Expansion Loops: Significant savings on expansion bends and loops in the piping route.
  • Greater Support Spacing: Savings on pipe clamps and fixed points along the route.
  • Dimensionally Stable Layout: No sagging of pipes in open runs or risers.

Homogeneous Polyfusion Welding: Leak-Free Performance for 50+ Years

The core of the K-Aqua piping system is the permanent, material-fused connection technique through thermal polyfusion. During welding, the pipe end and fitting socket are heated to exactly 260°C using an electronically controlled welding device, melting the polymer chains on the joining surfaces.

Upon joining, the melted macromolecules fully interlock on a molecular level. After cooling, a homogeneous, monolithic material structure is formed without seams, adhesives, or elastic seals. Because no rubber O-rings or mechanical press fittings are used, aging damage, gumming, or embrittlement of seals are things of the past. The weld seam is as strong as the pipe itself. The connection is permanently established in just a few seconds.

Optimal Flow Characteristics and High Energy Efficiency

Our PP-R piping system is not just a passive carrier for water but an active component of your building's energy concept. The inner surfaces are extremely smooth (absolute roughness roughly 0.007 mm), which drastically minimizes friction resistance compared to metal surfaces. According to the Darcy-Weisbach flow equations, this immediately results in lower pressure losses along the piping runs. Consequently, circulation pumps can run with less energy or be sized smaller. Over a lifespan of decades, these energy savings translate into a significantly reduced carbon footprint and drastically lower life cycle costs for the facility operator.

timeline.title: The Manufacturing Cycle
timeline.desc: A look inside our manufactory. The path from raw material to tested hybrid fitting is an orchestra of heat, pressure, and relentless precision.

items.title: Raw Part Machining (CW617N)
items.text: The brass is pressed into high-precision matrices at 750°C, followed by CNC-controlled machining in the micrometer range to create the sealing profile.

items.title: Surface Passivation
items.text: To eliminate galvanic corrosion, the threaded inserts undergo a multi-stage passivation process in electrolytic ultrasonic baths.

items.title: Injection Molding
items.text: In high-pressure injection molding machines (2,000 bar), the molten PPRCT encloses the brass. The plastic completely fills every undercut.

items.title: Controlled Cooling
items.text: A programmed, gradual temperature reduction prevents residual stresses in the plastic lattice and ensures the concentric dimensional accuracy of the fitting.

items.title: Pressure & Torsion Testing
items.text: Random burst tests up to 120 bar as well as fatigue tests simulate 50 years of the most aggressive continuous industrial stress.
